source.title: Living Weapon's Chain — LIVE Wowhead Looter aggregate disenchant table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated submissions)

notes: Source display row 1/2, epic plate waist; item introduced in patch 11.2.0 (not proof of sample patch). The current LIVE item page's cumulative Looter section reports 12 disenchant observations and 9 occurrences of a same-name Refulgent Crystal display row. Public searchable rendering does not expose this row's underlying linked item ID/quality rank or per-positive-cast stack sizes, so outputItemID/outputRank, totalQuantity, min/max and 0-inclusive histogram remain unknown. Do not infer no-output cases from unmatched row totals; multiple material rows can co-occur. Sample collection date, actual bonus/ilvl, full skill/spec, individual contributors and version are unknown. Disenchant does not consume refunded ore/herbs; no Resourcefulness basis reported. Raw Listview identity and data overlap must be independently checked before any estimator inclusion or current-patch gold valuation; this is research-only.
